sample_cases.question: What evidence is required for project submission?

retrieved_chunks.text: Project submission evidence requirement: Learners must upload repository GitHub links and a 3-minute video walkthrough demonstrating all test executions, architectural flows, and key modular components.
Assignment grading criteria: Submissions are evaluated on unit test coverage (40%), modular code structure (30%), and comprehensive documentation (30%). A score of 60% or higher is required to pass.
